# Parkside Advisory Group

Primary site: https://parksideag.com

Parkside helps operators put an owner on work that stalls.

## Offers

- Snapshot, free: https://parksideag.com/intake
- Security Check, $500: https://parksideag.com/security-check
- Blueprint, from $1,500: https://parksideag.com/blueprint
- Build, quoted after the Blueprint: https://parksideag.com/services

The Security Check is a practical operations and risk review. It is not a penetration test, audit, or certification. It is not legal, compliance, or insurance advice, and it does not guarantee against a breach.
